text: Nedbank Zimbabwe is the headline sponsor of the Zimbabwe Sables, the country's national men's rugby team.
short: Nedbank Zimbabwe is the Sables' headline sponsor.

source.name: GreatDykeNews24: Nedbank Strengthens Long-Term Support for National Sport After Successful Tour de Great Dyke
source.quote: It is the headline sponsor of the national men's rugby team, the Sables, and has extended its support to the Junior Sables
source.note: Nedbank Zimbabwe's own Instagram post of 26 June 2026 (https://www.instagram.com/p/DaDPdWegiO4/, opened 2026-10-04) calls the bank title sponsor of the Sables' Nations Cup 2026 campaign: 'As title sponsors we remain committed to powering their progress -on and off the field'. The caption is only readable in the page's og:title metadata, which a script's quote check cannot verify, so it is recorded here rather than as a claim source.
